videos.focus: Curtain wipe comparison slider dragging from 10% to 100% showing raw interferometric fringes vs. corrected ground displacement field.

videos.focus: Opening autonomous machine-readable STAC v1.0.0 order modal, scrolling sensor properties, and 1-click clipboard copy with verification toast.
